bus.via: Dong Seoul Bus Terminal to Gangneung Intercity Bus Terminal

trips.route_note: The KTX Gangneung line runs from Seoul Station (or Cheongnyangni) directly to Gangneung Station, with a short local bus ride to the coast.
trips.why: KTX reaches Gangneung in under 2 hours with a short local bus ride to the coast.
know: Book KTX seats ahead on weekends and holidays
Best in summer for the beaches, but crowded then
Gangneung Station is a short bus ride from the coast

bus.via: Dong Seoul Bus Terminal to Chuncheon Intercity Bus Terminal

trips.route_note: Take the ITX-Cheongchun or a subway/ITX combination from Seoul to Chuncheon Station, then a local bus or taxi to the lake and island areas.
trips.tour_query: Nami Island and Chuncheon day trip from Seoul
trips.why: ITX-Cheongchun is fast and frequent, then a local bus or taxi to the lake and island areas.
know: Best in spring for cherry blossoms and autumn for foliage
Local bus or taxi needed from the station to the lake
Book ITX seats ahead on weekends

bus.via: Dong Seoul Bus Terminal to Incheon Terminal Complex

trips.route_note: Subway Line 1 or the Suin-Bundang line reaches Incheon Station directly; from there local buses serve Chinatown, Wolmido and the airport area.
trips.why: Subway Line 1 runs directly to Incheon Station, with local buses to Chinatown and Wolmido.
know: Chinatown and Wolmido are a short local bus from Incheon Station
Allow extra time if continuing to the airport area
